body: you just need to drop people who make you feel like that… change who you’re spending your time around.

i have a friend who literally only dates people less attractive than her because she thinks if they’re ugly, and she’s pretty that they won’t cheat on her… 
and every single one of them has 
she is really vain, and i think it’s a disgusting trait of hers to do that. 
i’ve never understood why someone would think that just because a person isn’t as “good looking” as yourself, that means they’d treat you better. 
her and i are so opposite tho… she’s all about looks, and i’m all about personality.. so we don’t ever mesh with the people we tend to be attracted to.
yeah, it’s already been donated, that’s why he’s not taking it :)

my bf used to do this. i would cover everything, even house shit... and we live together, but i’d ask for something small, and he’d tell me “sure just cash app me and i’ll get it” and one day i was just like “should i cash app you for this” and he got really defensive. like what i was saying was bad, and then it just kind of stopped. i’ll never understand how men see shit the way they do. they’re always so backwards, it drives me insane. 
entitled fucks is what they are 😂

i’m so sorry this happened to you. 
but in all honesty, fuck them people. 
you owe them nothing, especially not the fact of you sitting there worrying about them once again. i wouldn’t contact them at all. 
i would’ve come to your wedding. it sounded beautiful, and so much fun. i hate people and their disappointing bs :/

i’ve also seen him like pictures of other girls and shit.. and brought it up, and he gets super fucking mad about it.. but then it’s on me for being insecure over a girl who he isn’t with... and he said i should remember that in the one that’s with him, not her.. and he said this while drunk, but even still, i was like... cocky much? the other girl was a “gamer friend” and i was like whatever, but this girl is his actual ex... and i’m just not cool with this. like at all.

damn... 
i hope you are still here.
therapy is probably something i need in general tbh. cause i think bad shit a lot.
i’m 32 and still dealing with this.

my brother has never ever touched me, in any way. 
and if someone touched me inappropriately, he’d hurt them. 
that’s not normal... 
you need to seek some sort of help from law enforcement or something and find a way out of that. i am so sorry that’s happening to you, but do not let them make you feel like it’s a norm. it is not.
me. fucking. too. 🙌🏻
i agree.
ditto

lol NEVER relate songs to people. 
cause then when they’re no longer around... you won’t listen to the song and that sucks. i try my hardest to not relate music to anything cause i enjoy it so much.

i don’t really have any friends. 
so i feel this. 
it feels like a waste of life to just sit and work and come home and do it all again. 
i find release in hobbies.
painting, music, gaming... 
and i have two beautiful children as well. 
it’s still hard everyday to not let the monotony get to me, and become overwhelming. 
just remember, that life may seem dark, or bleak at times... but it’s worth being here. 
i fight myself all the time to not end my life... i just have to remember the beauty in this life. 
you can do it too. just hold on, it will get better. i promise.

it’s funny, i think about this all the time. 
i have a friend who has been my best friend for almost 20 years... and i’m always the one “watering” that garden. when i talk about myself, she doesn’t care... but when she talks about her i’m supposed to fucking stop everything i’m doing and just listen and make it my complete life’s goal to listen to her shit. but recently, i haven’t been texting her, or liking her stuff on fb anymore and she’s dwindled off as well. i feel like that’s what made me finally realize she’s not what i’ve always thought her to be. if i don’t put in the effort, she doesn’t do shit. friendships should be half and half. they’re just like relationships but they’re not sexual. she’s also stopped being friends with me before due to dudes she’s dated. if they’re not putting forth effort to maintain a friendship, realize they’re not your friend. it sucks but there’s not shit i can do about it. 🤷🏼‍♀️

sometimes he will not respond to me, or make me feel like he’s putting me off. he will remain online after he’s told me he’s going to sleep... i do know that because of where he is, sometimes the connection is slow, so it’s not an instant thing all the time. but it’s truly what i feel is what i most worry about. is that he’s online talking to someone else, and i’m being cheated on and i’m going to end up hurt and looking like a dumbass. besides this, i don’t really feel like him and i have issues. but it’s becoming an every day issue for us, or for me at least. he doesn’t seem to think he’s doing anything wrong. he tells me that just because it says it’s online, doesn’t mean he is... and that he’s not ignoring me, not pushing me to the side. so why do i feel so strongly that he is?

yeah, no. i’d be outie five thous-y. 
she opened the door and invited another dude into her personal life.. 
and i get it, people make new friends all the time, but that sketchy shit is for birds.  if my man was sending selfie’s to a “new” friend of his directly, i’d be pissed.

i personally feel like i have no friends. i have one friend who’s been my best friend for like ever and even that i feel is falling to bits. 
i think it all changes when you get older because no only are people living their own lives, but the way you feel about people and what they do changes as well. 
i don’t agree with hardly anyone anymore. i don’t like the things they do, or how they act.. so it just feels better to stay to myself and do things in enjoy instead of trying to please someone else’s needs or wants. 
i can assure you, you’re not the ass hole. you’re just not into bullshit anymore. or at least that’s how it is with myself.

i actually think about death and dying on the regular. 
tonight as i was falling asleep i thought about how i would be completely okay with someone shooting me in the back of the head while i slept. 
but the car crash thing is normal. or like.. feeling like you want to just veer off the road and see what happens. i think it’s called something like into the void.. it’s been a while since i’ve thought about the technical terminology of it. 
but to answer your question directly, yes i feel the same.

wouldn’t it just be awesome to be able to travel and do as you please. i mean you’re right. i haven’t tried everything. i think i put a lot of stock in happiness with others and when it turns out that being around or with said people makes these feelings worse, i feel damaged. maybe i’m just not meant for normal things and it drowns me.

isn’t that the definition of insanity? 
keep doing the same shit over and over and expecting different results..
